# CRC Maesta

> CRC Maesta is a luxury residential apartment project located in Sector 1, Greater Noida West. Offering ultra-premium 3 BHK, 4 BHK, and Penthouse residences with modern amenities and modern connectivity.

## Project Summary
- **Project Name:** CRC Maesta
- **Location:** Plot No. GH/11 B, Sector 1, Greater Noida West, Gautam Buddh Nagar, UP – 201306
- **Developer / Promoter:** CRC Group (Promoter Registration: UPRERAPRM137312)
- **RERA Registration Number:** UPRERAPRJ724518/07/2024
- **Configurations Offered:** 3 BHK, 4 BHK, Penthouses
- **Official Website:** https://crcmaesta.properties/

## Key Features & Highlights
- Ultra-luxury residential towers with modern architecture.
- Strategic location in Sector 1, Greater Noida West with direct access to Noida, Ghaziabad, and Delhi-NCR.
- World-class clubhouse, swimming pool, landscape gardens, and sports facilities.
- Transparent buyer assistance, floor plans, and priority price list downloads.
